Final for Publication
NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment

1619 North Artesian Avenue
From RS-3 to RM-4.5

The Property
The property is located in an RS-3 zoning district in an area that includes RT-4, RM4.5, and multi-unit residential

buildings, many of them three stories in height.

The property is improved with a two-story four unit residential building and two surface parking spaces. The four
units are legal conforming. The building is in a dilapidated state and not suitable for habitation. The Applicant
applied for a building permit to rehabilitate the building and were told they would lose two grandfathered units if
they made changes to the building.

The Project

Kamil Kowalkowski and Piotr Kowalkowski (the “Applicants”) seek to rehabilitate the subject building and improve
upon the existing floor layouts. They propose to construct a third floor addition that will follow existing wall lines. A
detached two car garage is proposed. Four units will remain. Four bicycle spaces will be provided. The building will
be 33.0’ in height.

To allow the proposed project the Applicant seeks to rezone the property from a RS-3, Residential Single-Unit
(Detached House) District to an RM-4.5, Residential Multi-Unit District. The rezoning would allow the Applicants to
retain all four units and allow for larger floor area for the proposed rehabilitation.

The Applicants are also seeking all relief as needed, as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, through a Type-1
application under section 17-13-0300(D) and including: 1) an optional variation under section 17-13-1101-B to
reduce the required south side minimum side yard setback per section 17-2-0309 from 2.0’ to zero (existing); 2) an
optional variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the required minimum combined side yard setback per
section 17-2-0309 from 5.0’ to 4.90” (existing); 3) an optional variation under section 17-13-1101-B reduce the front
yard setback per section 17-2-0305-B from 13.26’ to zero (existing).

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 3,126 square feet

FAR: 13

Total Building Floor Area: 4,038 square feet

Residential Dwelling Units: 4 (existing)

MLA Density: 782 square feet

Height: 33.0°

Automobile Parking: 2

Bicycle Parking: 4

Rear Yard Open Space: 509 square feet

Setbacks: Front (West/Artesian Avenue): zero*
Side (North): 4.90°
Side (South): zero*
Rear (East): 50/54"

Aset of plans is attached.
* The Applicant seeks all available and optional variation relief under section 17-13-0300(D).
